constructed_generator: n=9, four-leaf pair-star plus disjoint triple; uniformly permuted labels, iid cubic weights in {1,2,3}, iid affine coefficients in {-2,-1,0,1,2}; separate mechanism cohort
candidate_budget_rule: min(32, number of full assignments with logical width <=12, number of capacity-feasible proper-mixed assignments); identical quota in both banks; no outcome-based proposals
candidate_initializers: reuse prefixes and common-pair buckets for proper mixed

compiler.scope: full p=1 product preparation + symbolic cost + matched product mixer
compiler.physical_Q: occupied logical input sites union sites touched after routing

quality_metric: gap=(original expectation-exact classical minimum)/(exact classical maximum-minimum); lower is better
selection: Within each declared budget choose minimum resource score independently in native/full/proper-mixed domains; ties lexicographic actions. No solution-quality outcome used for selection.

guardrail.domain: same proper-mixed proposal bank, device capacity only
guardrail.failure_rule: No feasible candidate => unavailable; do not relax threshold or substitute a candidate
guardrail.initialization: identical clipped single and pair relaxation moments across policies

qaoa.equal_effort: same starts across all candidates; seeded uniform quota completion on early termination
qaoa.scan_scope: union of capacity-only native/full/three mixed guardrail selections and primary-budget full/mixed selections; selected before any QAOA outcome

diagnostic_probe_selection: seeded sample of proper-mixed bank; independent of resources, diagnostics and QAOA outcomes
primary_questions: Per family, at the fixed primary budget and gap<=0.2, does the resource-selected mixed arm qualify while the selected endpoints do not?
Per family, does prepared guardrail increase availability-and-gap<=0.2 relative to no guardrail under capacity-only selection?
primary_statistics: instance-level counts and paired bootstrap; 10000 instance resamples; 97.5% intervals for two random-family guardrail contrasts; constructed cohort descriptive and separate
prediction_analysis: secondary: on eight predetermined proper-mixed probes per random instance, compare leave-one-instance-out linear prediction of final equal-effort gap and auxiliary inconsistency, controls=[aux count, compiled resource score, reduced-term count, warm-p0 normalized gap, family]; raw/prepared diagnostics added separately and together. Paired instance bootstrap on held-out MSE improvement, no causal claim.
secondary_statistics: full budget/quality grids descriptive, correlated; separate resource feasibility from quality conditional on availability; missing guardrail selection counts as failure for availability-and-quality rates
endpoint_certificate: Resource exclusion of every full assignment only if exhaustive logical width/penalty metadata excludes all; otherwise label failure as selected-baseline result, not global impossibility
acceptance: 72 unique objective polynomials and no exact overlap with supplied historical/revision sets
pointwise exactness and unique lift for all compiled candidates
raw/prepared diagnostic formula matches independent product-law enumeration
sampled compiled statevector agrees with independent state simulation including routing layout
all saved QAOA parameters and deterministic grid samples independently verified
positive experimental outcome is not required for completion
amendment_rule: Never silently change protocol after outcomes; operational failures retain original freeze and explicit amendment if scientific behavior changes
